name: Royal Enfield Ordnance 7.5mm Liquid Propellant Assault Rifle LPA1

system.flavor: A twin-magazine, liquid-propellant, variable-velocity bullpup assault rifle entering limited test service with the BCF. The propellant sits in a self-sealing armoured cassette in the butt; twin helical magazines of 45 caseless rounds each flank the receiver, so mixed ammunition types can be carried.
system.notes:
Cyberpunk 2020 CP3281 Rough Guide to the UK p.34 (PDF idx 34) text layer: RIF +1 N R Special 2x45 1/3/20 VR 500m 1800Eb. Three velocity settings, selected manually or by smart-link command: (1) Low - riot, 2D6+1; (2) Medium - urban, 4D6; (3) High - full combat, 6D6. Shots stored as the 90-round total of the two 45-round magazines.

Confirmed verbatim by Blackhand's Street Weapons p.29 (PDF idx 30), citing [Rough Guide UK]: 1800eb, RIF +1 N R VARIES (7.5MM) 2x45 1/3/20 VR 500M. The SAS 'Wasp Flechette' Reaper Round holds three darts backed with Royal Enfield B5 HE; each dart does the velocity setting in D6 with soft armor having no effect and hard armor at half SP.
system.source: Rough Guide to the UK p.34
